name: Kumo Forecast
description: Installs NVIDIA Kumo Relational (structured-data-models) and serves it as an MCP server on port 9244: it forecasts an outcome, described as rows of one of the dataset's tables, for the cohorts the cohort designer locks, over the tables of the cohort's dataset that the agent chooses, compares with classical baselines and writes the highest-risk members to a controlled bucket. With the agent-sandbox feature, the sandboxed agent drives it.

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user.

port.description: Port for the forecast MCP server

bindAddress.description: Address the server listens on. 127.0.0.1 (default) keeps it to this container; 0.0.0.0 lets the container publish the port to sandboxed agents on the same VM. KUMO_FORECAST_BIND overrides it at start.

role.description: app: the model and its server. broker: only the catalog the sandbox-broker renders the policy from.
